name: FaceTime Audio Enabler
tagline: 在 iOS 15–18 上启用 FaceTime Audio，并按系统版本采用对应的安全流程。
description: FaceTime Audio启用器为受区域限制的设备恢复 FaceTime Audio 功能，并保留 FaceTime Video 与 iMessage 的正常使用。
iOS 15–17 使用可逆的即时启用方式；iOS 18 使用带兼容性探测、原始备份、应用与恢复校验的持久管理流程。
notice: ⚠️ iOS 18 启用或停用后必须完整重启设备；Respring、sbreload 和 Userspace Reboot 均无效。若要卸载，请先在设置中停用并完整重启，确认恢复后再卸载。
features: 在受区域限制的设备上启用 FaceTime Audio
iOS 15–17 修改后自动重新加载相关服务
iOS 18 提供兼容性探测、原始备份、应用与恢复校验
显示系统版本、实现方式、当前状态、备份状态与安全结果
检测到不兼容或状态异常时自动禁止修改
支持 English、简体中文和繁體中文
usage: 安装后打开“设置”中的 FaceTime Audio启用器。
确认兼容性探测与状态检查通过后，开启 FaceTime Audio。
iOS 15–17 会自动重新加载相关服务；通常无需 Respring。
iOS 18 必须按提示完整重启设备；需要恢复原状态时先关闭开关并再次完整重启。

changes: 增强 iOS 18 的备份与恢复逻辑。
新增针对 iOS 15–17 与 iOS 18 的分版本 FaceTime Audio 启用流程。
新增兼容性探测、状态显示、原始备份及受保护的应用与恢复管理。
修复旧系统状态读取与设置入口显示问题，并增强三语设置体验。

en.name: FaceTime Audio Enabler
en.tagline: Enable FaceTime Audio on iOS 15–18 with a version-appropriate guarded workflow.
description: FaceTime Audio Enabler restores FaceTime Audio on region-restricted devices while preserving normal FaceTime Video and iMessage use.
iOS 15–17 uses an immediate reversible method, while iOS 18 uses a guarded persistent workflow with compatibility probing, original backup, apply verification, and restore verification.
en.notice: ⚠️ On iOS 18, enabling or disabling requires a complete device reboot; Respring, sbreload, and Userspace Reboot are not sufficient. Before uninstalling, disable the feature, complete a full reboot, and confirm restoration first.
features: Enable FaceTime Audio on region-restricted devices
Automatically reload related services after changes on iOS 15–17
Compatibility probing, original backup, apply verification, and restore verification on iOS 18
Display system version, method, current state, backup state, and safety result
Refuse changes automatically when compatibility or state validation fails
English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
usage: Open FaceTime Audio Enabler in Settings after installation.
Enable FaceTime Audio after the compatibility probe and status checks pass.
On iOS 15–17, related services reload automatically and a Respring is normally unnecessary.
On iOS 18, complete a full device reboot as instructed; to restore the original state, disable the switch and complete another full reboot.

changes: Improved backup and restore handling on iOS 18.
Added version-specific FaceTime Audio enablement workflows for iOS 15–17 and iOS 18.
Added compatibility probing, status reporting, original backup, and guarded apply and restore management.
Fixed legacy status loading and Settings entry presentation, and improved trilingual Settings support.
